messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — noticed a weird divergence: a bunch of function/tool invokes were routed to the degen path in us-west-2 but quota counters didn't increment. billing spike hit a few customers. opening thread to triage.

sara: ugh. any obvious schema rejections in the logs?

kevin: logs show validator rejecting structured output for ~50% of those calls (reason: extra top-level field), and router acting on the validator tag to route to degen. but meter pipeline ingested the original route id and then the degen path swapped model+route and we lost the meter tag.

maria: do you have an example payload and validator message?

kevin: pasted sample below (redacted):
```
REQUEST: {
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {"q":"price per token"},
  "metadata": {"request_id":"r-12345","route":"route_prod_usw"},
  "extra": {"user_note":"debug"} // <-- extra top-level field triggers strict schema reject
}
VALIDATOR: reject(reason=unknown_field:extra, mode=strict)
ROUTER: fallback_to=degen_route(usw, variant=cheap)
METER: ingest(route_id=route_prod_usw) then route swap -> meter drops tag
```

tom: so meter saw route_prod_usw but after routing to degen we didn't re-annotate outgoing billable event with degen route info? that would explain mismatch.

kevin: exactly. the degen path intentionally suppresses some billing tags for safety, but in this case it's inconsistent — we ended up charging the heavy model but dashboards showed degen counts.

ops-bot: alert: routing-fallback spike 2026-02-18T09:12:45Z — 312 fallbacks in 10m (us-west-2).

maria: action items I propose: 1) patch meter pipeline to re-evaluate route tag post-routing so final route is what gets billed; 2) add a transient metric for "route_swap_events" to surface when initial route != final route; 3) in console, add an ops table row for schema_reject->fallback rate by route.

sara: +1 on the route_swap_events metric. also we should avoid degen silently changing billing class. degen should never increase billed model class. fallback policy must assert cost cap.

kevin: agreed. quick mitigation: I'm going to patch router to copy current route label into the meter event before emitting. small hotfix. tom, can you add a quick dashboard tile to show meter vs billing divergence per customer? Even a rate-of-delta will help triage.

tom: on it. thinking: two bars — meter_count and billing_count over time, and a filter by route_tag. should be doable in 30-45m.

maria: longer term: we need clearer contract between validator, router, and meter. validator decisions must include an "effective_route_hint" in its event so meter can reconcile. and console UX should show when an invoke was "re-routed due to validation".

kevin: good note. also want a rollout UX tweak: when enabling stricter schema enforcement in canary, console should show projected "route fallback" rate and projected billing delta. we had a canary yesterday that was stricter and we didn't get that projection.

ops-bot: deploy-note: kevin/router-hotfix deployed to canary at 6612345690, rolling to prod paused.

sara: after the hotfix, please surface a one-off backfill job to tag the 10k affected events so billing + meter align for audit. customers will ask.

kevin: yes — backfill job scheduled, I'll post job id when started. thanks all.

maria: please file a postmortem gist with timeline + customer impact and link to this thread. we should also add a unit test in the meter pipeline that prevents losing final route_tag on route swap.

kevin: will do.
